Have you ever found yourself wishing you could walk into any room—whether it’s a big meeting or a difficult conversation—and just know you belong there? Maybe you’ve wondered why confidence seems to come so easily for some, while others constantly second-guess themselves. Together, we’re about to explore the fascinating puzzle of self-assurance and inner belief—those powerful forces that shape so many of our experiences, both at work and in our personal lives.
Guided by Katty Kay’s insights in The Confidence Code: The Science and Art of Self-Assurance – What Women Should Know, we’ll dive into how our biology, upbringing, and even the culture around us can quietly influence how confident we feel, especially for women. You’ll discover that confidence isn’t just something you’re born with or without—it’s actually a skill, one that anyone can nurture and grow. Along the way, we’ll meet women from all walks of life, hear real stories, and uncover the science that explains why some of us naturally project certainty, while others wrestle with doubt—often more so when expectations and pressures are silently stacked against us.
We’re going to challenge old myths, break down the hidden rules, and learn practical ways to build the kind of confidence that feels genuine—so you can trust your instincts, stand your ground, and grab the opportunities that truly matter to you. So, if you’re ready to see confidence in a whole new light, and maybe even unlock a version of yourself that’s been waiting in the wings, let’s take this journey together.
